title: *List: allow to provide an itemComponent
body:
There's currently no way to override the rendered item component in RefinementList, Menu, HierarchicalMenu and possibly others.

As soon as a user provides an itemComponent then the default itemComponent is no more used and the user will have to provide a react component being passed the data and the refine method to bind.

comments.body: From my experience using react-is for the tourism example, and IMHO this is so straightfoward to use the HOC that I don't think we need that.

> this is so straightfoward to use the HOC that I don't think we need that.
